pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nīhatādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.3: akataṃ kammaṃ dukkaṭaṃ kammaṃ puna kātabbaṃ kammaṃ anīhataṃ dunnīhataṃ puna nīhanitabbanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nīhatādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.6: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nīhatādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.9: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nīhatādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭessatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.10: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.11: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.12.1: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nīhatādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:2.1.6: sāmaṃ vā jānāti aññe vā tassa ārocenti so vā āroceti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:2.1.8: dhammena vinayena satthu sāsanena kataṃ etaṃ yathādhammaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:2.1.10: cattāri adhikaraṇāni vivādādhikaraṇaṃ anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ āpattādhikaraṇaṃ kiccādhikaraṇaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:2.1.12: akataṃ kammaṃ dukkaṭaṃ kammaṃ puna kātabbaṃ kammaṃ anīhataṃ dunnīhataṃ puna nīhanitabbanti ukkoṭeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:2.3.2: adhammena vā vaggena vā nakammārahassa vā kammaṃ katanti jānanto ukkoṭeti
